{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, especially at market bottoms where they undershoot the true bottom by 0.2-0.5",
    "When sentiment turns negative, model predictions are too slow to respond, creating persistent long bias in forecasts",
    "Mean reversion bias in model causes predictions to be too low during upticks and too high during downticks",
    "Sentiment alignment rule: when daily sentiment crosses from positive to negative, immediately shift forecast 0.2-0.3 below current level",
    "Price momentum mismatch: model lacks price velocity information, causing 1-2 day delays in following genuine price movements",
    "Volatility adaptation gap: model under-predicts extreme values by 0.5-1.0 compared to true outcomes",
    "Sentiment strength misalignment: model doesn't differentiate between weak and strong sentiment signals, leading to muted forecasts"
] }
